correctness.rationale: Under the explicit balanced-harmonic Gaussian model, direct integration and phase orthogonality prove the exact Fisher-rate formula. The logarithmic derivative is strictly decreasing on (0,pi/2), has exactly one zero, is negative to pi, and all later lobes have a provably smaller envelope. Implicit differentiation proves monotone overhead response, and a verified dominant-balance expansion gives x cubed ~3a/2 and loss ~(3a/2)^(2/3). Direct reconstruction and the extracted Python checker pass 36,583 supplementary tests, not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The exact unique exposure length, sharp 37.101%-of-period upper limit and nonanalytic 1/3 exposure, 2/3 efficiency-loss laws are concrete benchmark designs when setup overhead competes with harmonic temporal smearing. This solves all positive integration times for a motivated Fisher information objective, rather than merely restating the known sinc attenuation. The idealized assumptions prevent empirical extrapolation; the significance is the mathematically sharp design characterization.
